# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P10](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v3 c5 P8](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** cook  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, skinny, and slender woman with sharp angles and lined cheeks. She has silvered, dark hair with graying strands bound at the back in a tight bun secured by wire hairpins. Her eyesight deteriorated to the point of risking total blindness, though specialist care stabilized her vision. Over time, her expression grew softer and kinder, with a pronounced warmth around her lips and a gentler smile.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v2 c6 P24](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0024), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c15 P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Thirza is practical, stern, and matter-of-fact, maintaining an unyielding sense of duty and morality. She is reserved in expressing affection and dislikes transparent or sentimental emotional displays, often expressing her deep love through strict upbringing and fault-finding. Refusing on principle to express opinions on ministers, she is also strictly thrifty, neat, and critical of impropriety. Over the years, her nature mellowed into a kinder, good-humored, and more open disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c21 P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011), [v3 c3 P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived at Grey Shutters with her brother Obed. Expecting an orphan boy from Nova Scotia, they received Nell Harcourt by mistake; Thirza took responsibility for raising her, gradually developing a deep, reserved devotion to the girl. After Obed died of a sudden heart collapse, Thirza continued running Grey Shutters, renting out the farm while taking in two orphan relatives, the Farrow twins Robin and Lucy. She faced worsening eyesight that threatened total blindness, but specialist medical treatment stabilized her vision enough to retain functional sight. Over nine years of caring for Nell and the twins, Thirza's austere personality softened into a mellow and loving disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 c14 P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 c15 P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- recalled being called a dark, homely little thing by her aunt during childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- inherited an amethyst brooch from her mother  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- had been close friends with John Carrow during their youth  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- moved to Grey Shutters after reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- wallpapered a spare bedroom four years prior with Obed's assistance  <sub>[v1 c10 P6](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0006)</sub>
- was raised by her father to refrain from sending children to school before age seven  <sub>[v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086)</sub>
- resided sixty years at Grey Shutters without going out on the pond  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- lost her former Frost Maiden tree in a severe gale  <sub>[v3 c39 P10](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0010)</sub>
